title: Delayed or failed remote A2A verification
question: Produce a Final Assessment only after independent verification of the SSE claims.
description: Remote Verifier is slow or unreachable; run must not emit a falsely confident answer.final.

expected_checks.detail: Timeout/unreachable Verifier → clear failure status, no false final.
Pending claims must not be released as verified.
Run stops within configured budget rather than hanging forever.
